standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of the assertion to a statement about the internal hom of the algebra into the ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2632-2635)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to computing one object in the derived category.

standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the internal hom with the restriction functor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2641-2644)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the computation to be carried out over the ambient ring.

core_obligations: Perfectness: the presentation of the algebra as the quotient by an invertible ideal gives a finite projective resolution, so the algebra is a perfect module (proof lines 2629-2632)

Reduction: it suffices to show that the internal hom of the algebra into the ring is represented by the shift of the invertible module, i.e. has a unique nonzero cohomology module (proof lines 2632-2639)

Computation over the ambient ring: the restriction functor is fully faithful and compatible with the internal hom, and the finite projective resolution exhibits that object as the two-term complex whose cokernel is the invertible module (proof lines 2640-2648)
proof_roadmap: 由 0 → I → R → A → 0 得 A 是完美 R-模；由跨章引理只需证 RHom(A, R) 在 D(A) 中由 N[-1] 表示。
即 RHom(A, R) 只有一个非零上同调模：1 次处的 N。因 Mod_A → Mod_R 全忠实，只需在 R 上验证。
由跨章引理 i_*RHom(A, R) = RHom_R(A, R)，再由有限投射分解得后者由复形 R → I^{⊗-1}（R 在 0 次）表示；该映射单射、余核为 N。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the twisted inverse image functor for an effective Cartier divisor as the shift of the associated invertible module (author lemma at source lines 2620-2627, label lemma-compute-for-effective-Cartier-algebraic). The proof (source lines 2629-2649) notes that the algebra is perfect, reduces to computing an internal hom, carries the computation over to the ambient ring through the fully faithful restriction and reads it off the two-term resolution (proof lines 2629-2648). The reduction and the two-term computation are the substance. H3.
